title: Sepo 0.5.0: Self-Improvement Route and Performance Enhancements
body:
## What's Changed * Configure test CI runner fallback variables by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/436 * Add agent self-improvement route by @lolipopshock in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/451 * Add Linux support to local-runner tooling by @lolipopshock in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/453 * Update Codex runtime and GPT-5.6 default by @lolipopshock in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/459 * Limit Sepo test CI to source repository by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/463 * Prefilter entrypoint mentions by active event text by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/462 * Route bare mentions directly to answer by default by @lolipopshock in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/472 * Slim the README to a minimal front door by @lolipopshock in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/464 * Reframe the README around the landing-page arc by @lolipopshock in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/476 * Cache runtime setup by default (cache_mode) with a trusted seed workflow by @lolipopshock in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/475 * Cache the Claude CLI binary in setup-agent-runtime by @lolipopshock in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/479 * Write the changelog at release time instead of per PR by @lolipopshock in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/477 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/compare/v0.4.0...v0.5.0
This discussion was created from the release Sepo 0.5.0: Self-Improvement Route and Performance Enhancements.
